profile.title: Start your park history
profile.description: Save a private visit even if you only remember the month or year.

quickCreate.title: Add a visit
quickCreate.intro: Start with a simple visit. You can add everything you did in a later step.
quickCreate.privacy: This visit and your notes remain private.

success.title: Visit saved
success.description: Your visit to {{park}} is now in your private passport.
success.toast: The visit was added to your passport.

park.title: Choose the park
park.hint: Search among parks that are visible on the site.

date.title: Enter the date you remember
date.hint: The passport keeps your exact level of precision without inventing a day.
date.approximateHint: Turn this on if the period is still uncertain.
date.timeZoneHint: Optional. Enter an IANA time zone, such as Europe/Paris, only if you know it.

optional.title: Add optional details
optional.privateNoteHint: Only you can read this note.

validation.dayInvalid: That day does not exist in the selected month.
validation.timeZoneInvalid: The time zone is too long.
validation.noteTooLong: The private note cannot exceed 4,000 characters.

errors.signInRequired: Sign in to save this visit. Your entry remains available.
errors.generic: The visit could not be saved. Try again without losing your entry.
errors.parkSearch: The park search failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.parkNotFound: This park is no longer available.
errors.timeZone: The time zone is not recognised.
errors.date: The visit date is not valid.
errors.retryConflict: This attempt no longer matches the original entry. Check the fields and try again.
errors.network: The server response did not arrive. Try again: the visit will not be created twice.

assessment.title: How this park felt
assessment.description: Rate this specific visit from 0.5 to 5. This observation stays private and never changes the community rating or rankings.
assessment.commentPlaceholder: What stood out during this visit…
assessment.commentHint: Only you can read this comment. Maximum 4,000 characters.
assessment.deleteConfirmation: Permanently delete the rating and comment for this visit?
assessment.saved: Your experience for this visit has been saved.
assessment.deleted: Your experience for this visit has been deleted.

errors.invalidValue: Choose a rating from 0.5 to 5 in half-point steps.
errors.commentTooLong: The private comment cannot exceed 4,000 characters.
errors.conflict: This visit changed in the meantime. Its current state was reloaded; check your entry before trying again.
errors.recovery: We could not verify whether the change was saved. Your entry is still available; try again in a moment.
errors.save: Your experience could not be saved. Your entry is still available.

rideAssessment.description: Keep your impression of this specific ride, independently from your other rides.
rideAssessment.privateHint: This observation stays private and never changes community ratings or rankings.
rideAssessment.commentHint: Only you can read it. Maximum 4,000 characters.
rideAssessment.deleteConfirmation: Permanently delete the rating and comment for this ride?
rideAssessment.saved: The private rating for this ride was saved.
rideAssessment.deleted: The private rating for this ride was deleted.

errors.invalidValue: Choose a rating from 0.5 to 5 in half-point increments.
errors.commentTooLong: The private comment cannot exceed 4,000 characters.
errors.occurrenceNotFound: This ride is no longer part of your visit.
errors.conflict: This ride changed in the meantime. Its current state was reloaded; review your input before trying again.
errors.recovery: We could not verify whether the change was saved. Your input is still available; try again shortly.
errors.save: The rating for this ride could not be saved. Your input is still available.

selector.title: Choose attractions
selector.description: Select one or more attractions, including ones that have closed since your visit.

selection.title: Entries to add
selection.pendingRecovery: The last add result is uncertain. Retry it before sending your newer changes.

fields.confirmHistoricalConflict: I confirm despite a known date conflict
fields.confirmHistoricalConflictHint: Use this only when you are certain about this memory.
fields.timeUnavailable: A time can only be added to a visit with an exact day and a time zone.

timeline.title: Your timeline
timeline.normalized: The order was recalculated to keep it reliable. The displayed timeline has been reloaded.
timeline.emptyDescription: Select attractions to rebuild this day at your own pace.
timeline.deleteConfirmation: Permanently delete this entry from your visit?
timeline.pendingDuplicateRecovery: The result of adding this entry is uncertain. Check it: the same request will be replayed without creating a duplicate.

errors.visitNotFound: This visit cannot be found or no longer belongs to you.
errors.load: Your visit could not be loaded. Try again in a moment.
errors.attractions: The attractions could not be loaded.
errors.timeline: The timeline could not be refreshed.
errors.operation: The change could not be saved. Your input is still available.
errors.network: The server response did not arrive. Try again: the operation will not be duplicated.
errors.batchTooLarge: You can add up to 100 entries at a time.
errors.historicalConflict: The known dates do not match this visit. Confirm only if you are certain about your memory.
errors.versionConflict: This entry changed in the meantime. The timeline was reloaded; check it before trying again.
errors.idempotencyConflict: This attempt no longer matches the original operation. Check the data and try again.
errors.attractionUnavailable: This attraction is no longer available for the log.
errors.noteTooLong: The private note cannot exceed 4,000 characters.
errors.timeUnavailable: This visit needs an exact day and a time zone before it can accept a time.

messages.added: The entries were added to your visit.
